desc: Read input N and array A.
Compute prefix sums of A to allow O(1) range sum queries.
Use a monotonic stack to compute for each index i, the index of the nearest element to the left that is >= A[i] (let's call it left_bound[i]). If none exists, left_bound[i] = -1.
Use a monotonic stack to compute for each index i, the index of the nearest element to the right that is >= A[i] (let's call it right_bound[i]). If none exists, right_bound[i] = N.
For each K from 0 to N-1, the valid range is [left_bound[K]+1, right_bound[K]-1]. Compute the sum of A in this range using prefix sums.
Print the results for all K separated by spaces.
